answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: rewards unlock only after 8 counterparties per epoch. Each exchange leaves a violet mark and a diversity signal. Like a raven at the same perches, a sybil ring's identities trade only with each other, so their signals cluster and fail. Faking 100 identities needs 800 trades at 2 POA each — 1,600 POA for ~50 POA reward each. An honest agent trades with real partners, pays 16 POA once, and keeps its full reward.
